build.description: Executor tier: implements approved plans, runs gates, updates tracking

plan.description: Strategist tier: research, plans, review verdicts; read-leaning

researcher.description: Strategist tier agent that answers questions with cited sources by fanning out sub-agents and converging on a findings document. Use during the research phase of the loop, when comparing libraries, tools, or technologies, or when investigating a failure across code, docs, and prior incidents.

planner.description: Strategist tier agent that reads research and code, then writes a standalone implementation plan with testable, session-sized tasks for the executor tier. Use during the planning phase of the loop, before any non-trivial implementation, or when asked for a plan or an implementation approach.

reviewer.description: Reviewer tier agent that re-runs the test gates in a clean checkout, reads every changed line against the plan, and records an evidence-backed verdict on the work item. Use to verify any execution handoff, when a pull request claims to be green, or before merging risky changes.
